game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope, a slope primed for avalanche: the rescue climber must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Letter Lock: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the rescue sled.
theme: Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope: a slope primed for avalanche
core_gameplay_loop: In Avalanche Slope, repeat each round: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the rescue sled. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the lock_letters value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about lock_letters to power up the rescue climber and open the rescue sled.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Letter Lock
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Letter Lock' (Week 8 slot 1), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Avalanche Slope'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_letters changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Avalanche Slope.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
